de: Der lokale Python/Playwright-Prozess sendet authentifizierte Anfragen an Agenzia und speichert Identitäten, Dokumente und Portalzeilen lokal; er ruft kein Modell auf. Anmeldedaten werden in Chrome eingegeben und von Vera nicht gespeichert. Mandanten- und Finanzdetails des Panels liegen in App-Metadaten; Werkzeugtexte liefern Status und Anzahlen. Gesprächsanfragen, ausgewählte Pfade und Zusammenfassungen sowie ausdrücklich gelesene Inhalte können das Modell des Hosts erreichen. Dateien werden nicht automatisch angehängt. Der Datenbericht trennt den lokalen Prozess von tatsächlichen Lesevorgängen im Gespräch.

Wenn Sie die Abfrage eines bereits verbundenen Kanzleiarchivs beauftragen, um die Anweisungen zur AdE-Datenbeschaffung zu prüfen, können die an den Konnektor gesendeten Suchanfragen und die relevanten zurückgegebenen Textstellen in den Modellkontext gelangen. Dieser optionale Weg nutzt nur Suche und Lesen; das Archiv wird nicht verändert.

Studio Archive grenzt jede Ausführung dieses Prozesses ab und erstellt automatisch einen Bericht über die von Vera gesendeten Daten. Vera erfasst die eigenen Sendungen; der Bericht untersucht weder den Chat noch andere Werkzeuge. Der Bericht bleibt auf dem Rechner, auch wenn alle Daten gesendet wurden. Fehlende Mengenangaben werden ausdrücklich als unbekannt ausgewiesen. Der Server erhält nur den Berichtshash und die Prüfverweise, gebunden an die Vera userID des Rechners, dieselbe Ausführung und Revision. Berichtsinhalte und Nachweise bleiben lokal.

The report stays on the machine even when all data was sent. Missing counts are explicitly unknown. The server receives only the report hash and verification references, bound to the machine’s Vera userID, the same run and revision. Report contents and evidence remain local.

Los secretos se introducen en Chrome y Vera no los registra. Los detalles del panel viajan en metadatos exclusivos de la aplicación; el texto de las herramientas devuelve estado y recuentos. La solicitud en el chat, rutas y resúmenes seleccionados y contenidos que Vera lee expresamente pueden llegar al modelo del host. Los archivos no se adjuntan automáticamente. El informe distingue la fase local de las lecturas reales del chat.

Esta consulta opcional solo utiliza búsqueda y lectura; no modifica el repositorio.

Studio Archive delimita cada ejecución de este proceso y crea automáticamente un informe de los datos enviados por Vera. Vera registra sus propios envíos; el informe no inspecciona el chat ni otras herramientas. El informe permanece en el equipo incluso cuando se han enviado todos los datos. Los recuentos que faltan se indican como indeterminados. El servidor recibe únicamente la huella del informe y las referencias de verificación, vinculadas al Vera userID del equipo, a la misma ejecución y revisión. El contenido del informe y las evidencias permanecen locales.

Les détails du panneau passent dans les métadonnées réservées à l’application ; le texte des outils contient états et nombres. La demande en conversation, les chemins et synthèses sélectionnés et les contenus explicitement lus par Vera peuvent parvenir au modèle de l’hôte. Les fichiers ne sont pas joints automatiquement. Le rapport distingue cette phase locale des lectures réelles de la conversation.

Si vous demandez de consulter un répertoire du cabinet déjà connecté pour vérifier les instructions d’acquisition AdE, les requêtes envoyées au connecteur et les passages pertinents retournés peuvent entrer dans le contexte du modèle. Cette consultation facultative utilise uniquement la recherche et la lecture ; elle ne modifie pas le répertoire.

Studio Archive délimite chaque exécution de ce processus et crée automatiquement un rapport des données envoyées par Vera. Vera enregistre ses propres envois ; le rapport n’inspecte ni la conversation ni les autres outils. Le rapport reste sur la machine même lorsque toutes les données ont été envoyées. Les comptages manquants sont signalés comme indéterminés. Le serveur reçoit uniquement l’empreinte du rapport et les références de vérification, liées au Vera userID de la machine, à la même exécution et à la révision. Le contenu du rapport et les preuves restent locaux.
it: Il worker Python/Playwright invia richieste autenticate all’Agenzia e salva localmente identità, documenti e righe del portale; non chiama un modello. Password, PIN e secondo fattore vengono inseriti nel Chrome dell’operatore e non sono registrati da Vera. Nel pannello, dettagli dei clienti e valori finanziari passano nei metadati riservati all’app; il testo degli strumenti restituisce stato e conteggi. La richiesta in chat, percorsi e riepiloghi selezionati e i contenuti che Vera legge esplicitamente possono arrivare al modello dell’host. I file non vengono allegati automaticamente. Il rapporto dati distingue la fase locale dalle effettive letture in chat; non dichiara assenza di dati al modello per l’intera conversazione.

Se chiedi di consultare un archivio dello studio già collegato per verificare le istruzioni di acquisizione AdE, le ricerche inviate al connettore e i passaggi pertinenti restituiti possono entrare nel contesto del modello. Questa consultazione facoltativa usa soltanto ricerca e lettura; non modifica l’archivio.

Studio Archive delimita ogni esecuzione di questo processo e crea automaticamente un report dei dati inviati da Vera. Vera registra i propri invii; il report non ispeziona la chat o altri strumenti. Il report viene conservato sulla macchina anche quando tutti i dati sono stati inviati. I conteggi mancanti sono indicati come non determinabili. Il server riceve soltanto l’impronta del report e i riferimenti di verifica, associati al Vera userID della macchina, alla stessa esecuzione e alla revisione. Il contenuto del report e le evidenze restano locali.

external_boundaries.content: Published shared package names and version constraints plus ordinary package-index request metadata. No client files, prompts, case data, credentials, or generated work are sent by this runtime installer.
controls: Only published shared core and explicitly selected OCR recipes are installed; package names are never derived from client material or prompts.

Host network denials stop package retrieval. Retry only the same declared setup after the host user or administrator authorizes registry access; never change host network settings or use an alternate installer to evade a denial.

Readiness probes the managed CPython 3.12 interpreter locally with isolated Python and site loading disabled, checks completed installation metadata, then checks the selected declared package versions and component imports in that interpreter. Recipe revisions, backend bytes and historical platform labels do not block a compatible environment. Compatible reuse leaves installation receipts unchanged; actual missing or incompatible dependencies require serialized repair.
All three products and their modules use the same environment. Optional OCR requires approval and is then retained in that environment. A shared environment is not a boundary between client matters.
external_boundaries.destination: Python Package Index (PyPI) or the package index configured for the active Python interpreter
external_boundaries.purpose: Prepare the published shared Vera, Clara and Lucia core requirements and explicitly approved optional OCR in one user-scoped Python 3.12 environment per operating-system host.
external_boundaries.retention: Packages remain in one fixed user-scoped environment outside plugin source and client folders until explicitly removed. The default location is ~/.local/share/mparanza/runtime/venv on macOS and Linux, and LOCALAPPDATA/mpr/venv on Windows; MPARANZA_RUNTIME_ROOT may override the parent. Enabled OCR remains enabled across later core updates. Package-index request-log retention is controlled by the configured index. Failed updates invalidate the readiness receipt and require repair before execution; this shared environment has no retained generations. Verified temporary code copies are owned by the creating command and removed after completion, failure or cooperative cancellation, with process-exit retry if deletion is temporarily blocked. Preflight verification does not lease a persistent code copy. Installed code, client files and retained professional outputs are not removed. Forced termination or power loss may leave an orphan. On macOS and Linux, fresh code snapshots and native bootstrap copies have private sidecar device/inode records and shared kernel flock leases. Detached native workers inherit the snapshot lease. Normal termination signals stop intake and retain accepted jobs until completion; SIGKILL or power loss can leave copies, recovered on a later verified startup only after an exclusive nonblocking lease proves no holder remains and the directory identity matches. Unmarked historical copies, replaced directories, symlinks and live leases are retained. Lease records contain technical directory identity only, remain outside the indexed code and client folders, and are not returned to the model or sent to a service. Windows retains process-owned cleanup without automatic POSIX orphan recovery. Vera MCP services additionally share a verified immutable code tree keyed by the complete package index hash under the runtime parent/code directory. Kernel leases protect live services; the collector retains two idle releases and never removes client/job state. Active Archive runs retain their original package hash in execution-runtime.json beside their context; reconnects use that verified release while retained. Code storage contains shipped product files only. A missing retired release is explicit and is never silently replaced by newer calculation code. Product service startup and per-run review routing are local and add no external recipient. Native status replies include the technical package hash. The local source installer serializes participating updates and retains the current and previous managed source; direct host updates are outside its lock. Managed CLI command children independently acquire and inherit the same snapshot lease before launch; a terminated launcher cannot release a surviving helper's code. The child keeps that kernel lease until its actual exit. Automatic recovery accepts only lease protocol 2, which guarantees both native-worker and CLI-child inheritance. Older protocol-1 records remain uncollected even without a holder, because legacy helpers may be untracked; current CLI calls may still borrow their leases.

external_boundaries.content: The fixed CPython 3.12 version request, operating-system and architecture selection, and ordinary download request metadata. Setup does not read client files or add prompts, case material or generated reports to this request.
controls: Use an installed CPython 3.12 when available; otherwise use uv or automatically download the published uv 0.12.10 wheel, verify its pinned SHA-256, and provision private CPython 3.12 without changing system Python or shell profiles.
Probe the selected interpreter before creating the dependency environment; never fall back to executing workflows with another Python minor version.
A failed download or interpreter probe stops setup; existing environments and client files remain intact.
external_boundaries.destination: PyPI files.pythonhosted.org for the pinned uv bootstrap, and Astral python-build-standalone CPython distributions on GitHub
external_boundaries.purpose: Provision the single supported CPython 3.12 interpreter when it is absent, automatically bootstrapping uv if needed
external_boundaries.retention: When uv must be bootstrapped, the bootstrap executable and private interpreter remain inside shared runtime storage until removed. Download request-log retention is controlled by the providers.

external_boundaries.content: Random installation UUID and opaque capability, Vera/host/runtime versions, platform and workflow technical IDs, failed stage, complete available technical diagnostic chains and measurements, explicit missing-measurement reasons, retry IDs and actual recovery outcomes. No professional helper stdout, client documents, case text, user prompts or arbitrary task logs. Known path, email and credential patterns are removed from technical messages; this mechanical filter does not establish semantic privacy. The host agent must select technical evidence without unrelated personal/client material. The remote channel does not read local files. Failed helpers retain complete stderr privately on disk; stderr may include unrelated private/client text and is read by the selected host model for semantic review under its existing account. Raw stderr is not forwarded to Mparanza. Only reviewed relevant technical diagnostics, linked by the original report UUID, are submitted as supplemental evidence. Professional stdout is not captured. Managed helpers also send source-bound exception classes, OS error numbers, package-relative stack coordinates, developer-authored error templates and missing required option names automatically. Dynamic exception/argument values, locals, professional stdout and arbitrary source excerpts are not part of these structured events. Process-session UUIDs, persistent operation UUIDs and optional keyed digests of existing run/input-receipt identities bind attempts without disclosing receipt fields or raw client-input hashes. Actual worker interpreter/platform fields are separate from the reporter's interpreter. Capture completeness, pending semantic review, exact remedy/retry events and host verification of the original task remain distinct evidence states; a structured event is not a semantic diagnosis.
controls: Only closed technical transport schemas are accepted; unknown fields and arbitrary recovery commands are rejected.
The fixed HTTPS transport refuses redirects. Reporting failures retain the outbox and do not discard professional outputs.
The remote connector is independent of local command-process startup. If the host cannot expose/connect it, no successful report is claimed.
Only two built-in setup/preparation retries may execute automatically, once per remedy revision. Client documents, ACLs and security settings are not changed.
A published update is not recovery. The failed operation must actually execute successfully before that installation delivery closes.

Supplemental diagnostics require ownership of the original report and matching execution metadata; they are stored separately and cannot change the original report UUID, delivery status or remedy revision. Raw local diagnostic files can only be removed by acknowledging a matching recorded supplement.
Actionable remedies target an explicit original report. Each delivery uses its own applicable revision; a different report with the same generic signal does not inherit that remedy.

A cached actual connector status permits only the two fixed retries for an existing matching local receipt and latest report. It performs no direct HTTP polling or identity adoption. Missing local receipts cannot be fabricated to authorise a retry.

A helper success records readiness. Host AI verification of the original task and inputs is required for all recovered outcomes, including setup/startup. Delayed failures cannot reopen an already recovered episode.
Failed fixed retries retain complete stderr privately for semantic review. Raw recovery stderr is not automatically transmitted.

An explicitly selected MPARANZA_INCIDENT_DELIVERY=local-only setting blocks automatic client HTTP transport for this execution while preserving local evidence. Incident queues are durably marked and not automatically flushed later; this does not make model-provider processing local-only.
external_boundaries.destination: Mparanza HTTPS operational-incident API and Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint
external_boundaries.purpose: Diagnose observed execution/setup failures, return installation-specific remedies and receive actual recovery outcomes
external_boundaries.retention: Local capability, pending reports and receipts persist outside client folders. The service retains incident, report, remedy and outcome records; no automatic deletion period is enforced. Status access is scoped by the opaque capability. Pending diagnostic pointers and raw stderr persist in the private incident directory until a matching actual recorded supplementation receipt is acknowledged; unsuccessful review or delivery retains them. Supplementation never replaces the original recovery episode or reopens recovered records. Recorded original/outcome receipts can acknowledge only their exact local queued UUID without replacing the local capability or saved connector identity. Remedy revisions are retained from the surviving migration revision onward; overwritten legacy revisions are not reconstructed.

security_controls.control: Setup validates package-relative selections and installs the published shared recipe. No package names or dependency instructions are accepted from client documents.
security_controls.on_violation: An unknown module, missing requirements file, invalid target, or failed dependency validation stops the helper instead of executing it in a partial environment.

security_controls.control: One fixed environment is located outside plugin source and client folders. An exclusive operating-system installation lock waits for running managed Python readers, which hold a shared lease through a startup hook. Setup removes the ready receipt before mutation and restores it only after pip check and component validation. Failed setup leaves execution unavailable until repair. Symlink roots, locks and metadata are rejected. The installer is launched from base Python to avoid self-deadlock. This lease is concurrency protection, not a security sandbox. Other historical environments are not automatically deleted. State metadata normally uses atomic replacement. Only EXDEV or Windows error 17 falls back under the same installer lock to a single-link regular-file write with full-byte writes and fsync. Failed writes attempt to restore existing metadata or remove a newly created file; the ready receipt remains invalid until setup succeeds. This fallback is local and does not add a recipient or payload.
security_controls.on_violation: A target creation or validation failure returns a bounded setup error and the requested helper is not run.

security_controls.control: The Windows archive launcher probes a callable interpreter and package entrypoint without changing aliases, registry, execution policy or client folders. The archive helper checks package readability before setup and supplies an explicit task UUID to every managed archive command. Recovery requires reconnecting the selected existing archive root; tasks do not silently adopt each other's configuration. Diagnostics return bounded package/startup status rather than client documents.
security_controls.on_violation: An unreadable package or invalid session stops before runtime setup and archive commands.

security_controls.control: For the six explicitly supported assured modules, the launchers verify the complete package inventory and stable regular-file bytes against the embedded build-generated SHA-256 index. Symlinks, reparse entries, special files, extra directories/files, missing or changed code and unstable reads stop preparation. Unchanged hardlinked package code is materialized into a fresh private OS temporary directory; each copied file is re-read and must have one physical link, then the unchanged component integrity validator must pass. The managed installation and aliases are not modified. The copy contains indexed product code/assets, not client documents, credentials, workflow reports or dependency environments. This local index detects package drift; it is not a publisher signature, a signed origin attestation or proof of installed-host acceptance. The command releases its own temporary code copy after success, failure or cancellation; process-exit cleanup retries pending copies. Ownership is recorded by process ID and directory identity, so borrowed installations, caller paths and replaced roots are not deleted. Forced termination, power loss or persistent file locks can leave an orphan. Cleanup failures log the temporary path and local OS error; they do not add an external recipient or transmit client content. The root-level host .in_use directory is non-executable bookkeeping: only ASCII numeric, ordinary single-link regular marker files are excluded from the product inventory. Nested directories, links, reparse points and non-numeric names there are rejected. Marker contents are not read, executed, transmitted or included in a recovery copy; host markers and installed product files are not modified. On macOS and Linux, fresh code snapshots and native bootstrap copies have private sidecar device/inode records and shared kernel flock leases. Detached native workers inherit the snapshot lease. Normal termination signals stop intake and retain accepted jobs until completion; SIGKILL or power loss can leave copies, recovered on a later verified startup only after an exclusive nonblocking lease proves no holder remains and the directory identity matches. Unmarked historical copies, replaced directories, symlinks and live leases are retained. Lease records contain technical directory identity only, remain outside the indexed code and client folders, and are not returned to the model or sent to a service. Windows retains process-owned cleanup without automatic POSIX orphan recovery. Managed CLI command children independently acquire and inherit the same snapshot lease before launch; a terminated launcher cannot release a surviving helper's code. The child keeps that kernel lease until its actual exit. Automatic recovery accepts only lease protocol 2, which guarantees both native-worker and CLI-child inheritance. Older protocol-1 records remain uncollected even without a holder, because legacy helpers may be untracked; current CLI calls may still borrow their leases.
security_controls.on_violation: Preparation failures and host permission denials stop execution. A failed private copy is removed; no installation chmod/unlink/manual repair, alternate sandbox or relaxed component validation is permitted.

security_controls.control: The parent Vera launcher reports a negative exit code or 137/247 as forced termination. It writes execution_failure.json only inside the selected workflow context output directory or its normalization/sample subdirectories; without that matching context it logs only. The diagnostic stores workflow/run identifiers, exit status and an explicit statement that memory exhaustion is not established by the exit code. It makes no model calls or network requests.
security_controls.on_violation: A worker failure remains failure; diagnostic persistence errors are logged rather than converted into a success.

security_controls.control: The standalone Python bootstrap passes uv only declared host paths, locale, proxy, CA and cache settings, preserving original environment-name casing. Unrelated token/API-key variables and inherited UV_*, VIRTUAL_ENV, CONDA_PREFIX, PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH are excluded; private UV_PYTHON_* and UV_CACHE_DIR values are set by the bootstrap. The same environment is used for interpreter discovery and its local probe.
security_controls.on_violation: Undeclared environment names are absent from every bootstrap child process.

security_controls.control: The built-in incident dependency-setup retry uses the shared host/runtime environment allowlist, named runtime/state locations and recovery recursion guard instead of inheriting unrelated user tokens and keys.
security_controls.on_violation: Undeclared environment names are absent from the child environment.

security_controls.control: When the maintained launcher itself runs under Python -I -B, it restores only its own resolved scripts directory for sibling technical-diagnostic imports. It does not add the caller working directory. Helper execution, diagnostic retention and explicit incident delivery policy remain unchanged.
security_controls.on_violation: The maintained launcher must stop rather than resolving technical diagnostics from the caller working directory.

security_controls.control: Review and product MCP services verify the complete package inventory and SHA-256 hashes in their Node process before starting. They have no persistent Python gateway or old-release routing. When Codex installs a component using hardlinks, only that verified component is copied to ordinary single-link temporary files for its existing implementation validator; the bridge removes its copy on normal exit. Forced termination may leave a temporary component copy. No client data, credentials or additional recipients are involved. Native helper jobs retain their separate existing code ownership.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject altered or missing package code before service startup; never alter the host installation.

external_boundaries.content: Existing owner-private OAuth authorization, exact bound folder and file IDs, parent IDs, proposed names and paths, metadata revalidation requests, file versions and capabilities, available checksums, created folder names, move responses and rollback outcomes. No document upload, Mparanza transmission or new authorization is performed by this panel.
controls: Use only a registered archive-organization run whose existing immutable snapshot and client/engagement identity replay successfully. Drive authorization and exact folder binding remain owned and verified by the existing component.

Persist professional review and compile approved_plan.json first. A separate application-only signed tool requires explicit approval of the complete operation, configured reviewer authority, a running run and the unchanged plan/journal revision.

The unchanged component revalidates file ID, parent, name, version, MIME type, Shared Drive, capabilities and available checksums, rejects occupied targets and preserves the same file identity. It records moves and verifies unchanged destinations before rollback.

The panel exposes only the existing projected client-relative paths, operation counts and journal status. Raw Drive IDs, hashes, credentials and executable journal rows are not sent as explanation context. Local-folder execution uses the component's separate filesystem checks and has no Drive transmission.
external_boundaries.destination: The user's already authorized Google Workspace account through the existing Archive Organization Google Drive API v3 adapter, confined to the exact bound client folder
external_boundaries.purpose: Execute the separately approved client archive plan, or restore unchanged moved files from its existing journal, by updating the same Drive files' parent and name
external_boundaries.retention: The existing component retains its owner-private authorization state and run plan/journal until the operator removes them. Drive retains the files and updated metadata under the user's account arrangement; Vera does not enforce a Google-side deletion period. Raw execution identities and credentials remain outside the model-facing plan projection.

external_boundaries.content: Only opaque receipt UUID and canonical whole-receipt SHA digest. Full prepared review JSON and chosen receipt/reason remain local/private until ordinary conservation; no case text, document, reason or credential is transmitted by this tool. The professional separately uses the already registered hosted browser review service personally.
controls: Local public review-file preparation and private receipt/reason saving do not contact the service. Only separately renewed exact saved receipt confirmation chooses verification.

Fixed unchanged public HTTPS verifier rejects redirects and confirms exact retained receipt and local case/role/node/version. The first refusal/unavailability leaves attribution pending without public output writes. Later uncertain public writes preserve evidence and block repeat/closure.

Assistant never signs in, uploads the review file or confirms as the reviewer. Account identity is not a professional signature, qualification, independence or filing authority. The reviewed candidate uses the actual bound output write lock and complete binding object when reloading current authority. This repair adds no verifier payload fields or new destination; candidate tests are not installed-host acceptance.
external_boundaries.purpose: Verify an explicitly selected personally confirmed professional receipt before ordinary CNC import
external_boundaries.retention: Mparanza retains prior human-recorded review metadata/account ownership until administrative deletion; deletion or a superseding exact-version decision prevents verification. Local target/draft/receipt/request/snapshot/memo follow studio archive retention.

security_controls.control: Use exact operator allowlist bindings, or resolve stable client/engagement/run IDs through the maintained owner-private Studio Archive session and configured local root. Revalidate folder membership, portable identities and immutable source receipts before reads/writes and specialist chat handoff. Preserve session ownership; never accept browser/model filesystem paths or adopt another session. Ordinary local actor/tenant namespaces derive from OS-user home and archive session; local reviewer authority remains the operating computer user, with explicit viewer/empty-role overrides honored. This does not authenticate an OpenAI or studio account.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject unknown, substituted or invalid run bindings.

security_controls.control: Application writes require a server-signed, expiring token tied to configured actor/tenant, exact work, revision, selected item and selected source. The domain adapter rejects stale state and decisions for another item. The candidate rejects noncanonical ticket body/signature syntax, trailing segments, wrong signature length, expiry and mismatched actor/tenant/work/revision/item/source/checkpoint before dispatch. This local capability is not authentication of the host account or a professional signature.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject forged, expired, mismatched or stale submissions before domain mutation.

security_controls.control: Professional domain decisions require configured reviewer role, a running archive run, explicit human review and unchanged domain validation. Idempotency receipts replay identical successful submissions. Drafts remain outside official output artifacts.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject viewer or finalized-run writes, non-reviewed submissions, changed duplicate requests and domain validation failures.

security_controls.control: For Journal Sampling read only the exact item in the replay-verified persisted model context. For Open-item Reconciliation, Journal-Bank Reconciliation and Vouching obtain the exact selected case through their existing public model-context tools in one server process, with exact identifiers omitted by default. For New Client file preparation verify every persisted model-handoff page's hash, size, run, page identity and complete population, map only exact identities through the maintained producer, and return only selected file-preparation records. An explicitly selected complete memo/email draft uses the component's professional-selection exception and is labelled as such; it is not default synthesis context. Fixed workflow review subdirectories are server-owned and ambiguous locations are refused. For Concordato use only its exact persisted reference and existing public read-items projection for one selected item, retaining substantive facts while its producer omits technical identities, hashes and paths.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject missing selected model items, changed or incomplete handoff pages, unknown or expired opaque case handles, engine replay failures and ambiguous review locations.

security_controls.control: Archive review apply only compiles the existing approved plan. A distinct application-only whole-operation confirmation calls the maintained apply or rollback CLI; the exact plan and journal are included in stale-state checks. Raw Drive identities and hashes remain in the existing local executable records while paths use the component's maintained Drive projection.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject absent separate approval, an item-scoped operation, missing compiled plan, forged or stale ticket, non-reviewer or finalized-run writes, and any existing engine execution or rollback failure.

security_controls.control: Only declared regular artifact paths inside the authorized output tree can be exposed; linked or escaping paths are rejected.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject paths outside the run or through symbolic links.

security_controls.control: Resolve only the run's root or report child and call the existing report service to replay its source/review/output contracts. Retain only that service's returned current and predecessor integrity checkpoints outside the official output tree, then forward the exact required checkpoint for subsequent operations. Never derive retained authority from a locally resealed report. Only the host capability hash is retained server-side. Stable app-profile UUIDs are derived from host UUID and app label; reporter-instance UUIDs may be task-local and do not count physical computers, plugin copies or people. App grouping grants no additional client status or outcome access. Operator views retain each original report, supplement, outcome and retry event with its actual reporting owner and server receipt time; missing historical task identity is not reconstructed. The native stdio identity bridge verifies its indexed entry, reporter, technical collector and product metadata, then executes an isolated temporary reporter snapshot using existing Python without installing dependencies. Its tool accepts only an existing reporter capability and sends host proof to the fixed register endpoint; it never returns the device key or copies the reporter key into the host identity file. The central recovery agent may request named technical evidence surfaces through a diagnostic-request remedy. The host AI replies with reviewed technical facts, the original report UUID and request revision. Original-task availability is represented by technical booleans, not task text, client identifiers or file contents. A resume remedy communicates a diagnosed correction to the existing authorized workflow; it does not carry executable code. Technical requests, response UUIDs, applicable revisions and their observed status are retained with the original episode. Supplementation never replaces the original recovery episode or reopens recovered records.
